title: Cosmetics Business picks: 7 November beauty launches to know
summary: This week’s best new-in beauty includes Mielle’s entry into body care, fresh Lip Treatment shades from Ayesha Curry’s Sweet July, skin care from Rodial and Innisfree and a new scent from Memo Paris

title: État Libre D'Orange acquired by Weinberg Capital Partners opening ‘new chapter’ for niche fragrance brand
summary: As part of the deal, former Chanel Parfums Beauté and Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle executive Hélène Lévy will take on the role of CEO

title: Prada Beauty teases VIP performer for Prada Piano pop-up in London
summary: The pop-up celebrates the launch of Prada Paradigme Le Parfum, which debuted in summer 2026, with a special guest set to be unveiled

title: Essential Parfums opens debut London flagship boutique
summary: The boutique, which has opened in the heart of London shopping destination Carnaby Street, builds on Essential Parfums' launch into the UK – with plans to open in 20 more global doors in the next three years

title: L’Oréal Paris and Ariana Greenblatt spotlight street harassment in new campaign
summary: As part of the United Nations’ (UN) 16 Days of Activism Against Gender-Based Violence, L’Oréal Paris and actress Ariana Greenblatt will spotlight the beauty brand’s Stand Up Against Street Harassment programme
